stem: The data set \(4, 7, 8, 9, 13, x\) consists of 6 values, where \(x\) is an integer greater than 13. Which of the following statistics of the data set does NOT depend on the value of \(x\)?
solution: Since \(x > 13\), the values in order are \(4, 7, 8, 9, 13, x\), whatever \(x\) is.
The median is the mean of the 3rd and 4th values, \(\frac{8 + 9}{2} = 8.5\), which does not involve \(x\).
The mean, the range \(x - 4\) and the greatest value \(x\) all change when \(x\) changes.

explanation.A: Correct. With \(x\) the largest value, the two middle values are always 8 and 9, so the median is 8.5 for every such \(x\).
explanation.B: Incorrect. The mean is \(\frac{41 + x}{6}\), which changes when \(x\) changes.
explanation.C: Incorrect. The range is \(x - 4\), which changes when \(x\) changes.
explanation.D: Incorrect. The greatest value is \(x\) itself.
